name: Late Rent Desk
office_task: For a landlord with 1 to 50 doors: each day, find who is really behind on rent, text only them, and hand notices, fees and hardship to a person.
systems_of_record: the property management system or rent ledger that issues the tenancy_id (its tenancy ledger, rule store and message log)

emits.write: the sent copy of each released arrears SMS (body, recipient tenancy, timestamp), filed in the message log against the tenancy_id, after every stop condition was checked against a fresh ledger read
emits.readback: reading the message log by tenancy_id returns the message with its tenancy_id, body and sent time; if the new copy does not read back, the desk raises rent.message_not_filed and the sequence goes no further

emits.write: an exception on the tenancy naming the person who owns it: a stop condition that matched, a failed or stale ledger read, no dated rule for the state, a notice drafted and held for a named release, a fee held for a person, hardship stated, or a sequence that went unanswered
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the tenancy_id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
